name: Abu Dhabi Investment Council
rationale: Independently-run Mubadala-affiliated sovereign AUM vehicle; co-invested alongside NVIDIA and Third Point/Apollo/Citadel in Nscale's pre-IPO raise. Only parent Mubadala is on the sovereigns watchlist today — flagging ADIC as a distinct legal vehicle worth tracking separately for deal attribution, per the vehicle-vs-parent convention used for M12/GV/NVentures.
